steps.label: 1410-lab-cache-all-select
command: (() => {const m=document.querySelector('#cacheReloadModal.show');if(!m)throw Error('Cache dialog absent');const c=m.querySelector('[data-check-all]');if(!c)throw Error('All selector absent');c.click();return {action:'Select all cache options locally; no reload'};})()

steps.label: 1416-lab-session-master-user-local-select
command: (() => {const m=document.querySelector('#sessionExpireModal.show');if(!m)throw Error('Role dialog absent');const c=[...m.querySelectorAll('input')].find(e=>e.value==='MASTER:USER');if(!c)throw Error('Observed MASTER USER option absent');c.click();return {action:'Select MASTER USER locally; no logout'};})()
